review_description: System sounds expensive but it was 2017

The solar quoting process was straightforward and the sales rep provided a range or system options based on entry level to premiuim system configurations.We selected a mid-range system using JA solar panels and an ABB inverter with the panel output slightly exceeding the invertor capacity to increase the overall capacity factor. ( 4.7kw/4.0kW)

My sales person was very knowledgeable and designed a system perfectly to suit our immediate needs. The other companies tried to sell me a much larger and more expensive system which wasn't necessary.

The sales representative from Energus rang up straight away when we requested quotes. He was prompt and polite, sent through his quote that day as promised, and was responsive and patient with all our follow-up enquiries. We were happy with the products suggested.The installation seemed to go well - the electrician was punctual and polite, worked hard and left the site quite tidy. There was a misunderstanding between him and the sales rep around the provision of tilt frames, but luckily it all turned out for the best. He took the time to explain and demonstrate the new inverter system and the online monitoring. We were very pleased.However, a few days later our roof started leaking in a heavy downpour - something that had never happened before - in a spot close to where the panels had been installed. To Energus' credit, we emailed them immediately and the electrician was at our door early next morning to check over his work.  The fix he made seemed to do the trick, and both he and Energus' operations manager made a second visit to our place the following week to double-check.The customer service during and after the install was alright - a few requests had to be repeated before gaining a response. However we think that Energus did a decent job with salvaging a difficult situation with a new customer, by being prompt, apologetic and taking responsibility. We will be monitoring the new set-up over the coming year and are looking forward to saving money on our electricity bill.

Quotes within 24 hours, not pushy with sales, willing to give options and happy for me to go and source other quotes before returning. Easy to get in contact with and were clear with instructions.Installers were prompt and kept in contact as to when they would arrive, finished before estimated time, cleaned up after themselves and even sent photos of the install to me afterwards and helped set up monitoring.Within a Couple of days, paperworkâ€™s weâ€™re done with instructions on how to get solar meter installed.Also got a phone call to ensure it was all done a few days later.Many thanks to Dennis for a great price and plenty of explanation and information on the products. Jaekwon for the install and Shashank for the after sales care

I got 3 quotes from Solar Quotes and Energus is the most customer service oriented company from start to finish.On sales, Gaurav was always very patient with all my queries even if it took me 3 weeks to do my own research and he was always there to answer my questions. I had a couple of changes that I requested from adding Solar Analytics to changing to Fronius inverter and he accommodated all my requests with reasonable pricing.Next, on custom service department, Shashank has been very helpful in updating me on when the installation will take place even in the middle of COVID-19 outbreak. He also helped me set up my Solar Analytics software and helped me prepare the paperworks for the smart meter change to my energy provider.And lastly, the installers lead by Jake were great. They (4 people) did a fantastic job. They didnâ€™t eat lunch because it started to rain at that time and they just finished the work to avoid the heavy rainfall. They leave our premises neat and tidy. They also accommodated my request to install the inverter inside the garage to avoid exposure to direct sunlight. They came around 8:45am and finished by 1:30pm.

Rob made the sales and quoting process very easy, he was able to answer all my questions, and was always prompt and proffesional when getting back to me.The installation was quick and tidy, the guys even helped me Setup the fronius monitoring and explained how to operate the system and cable runs for me.The customer service from Rob and Shashank were great, always willing to help by answering my questions and offering advice which aligned with everything on Solarquotes. They were the only installer who offered solar analytics and were happy to install along with the PV.

The quoting and booking processes was a bit slow compared to the another pushy installer, but everything was done right, and now I actually appreciate the quality and altitude of the Energus team. I need to mention Rob, he is knowledgeable, transparent and easy to deal with. Customer service was great, everything well-documented, and helped organize the grid connection (though I was impatient and did that myself before they help).
Energusâ€™es quote was the best value for money. Rob was great to deal with and the installation went without a hitch. Perfect setup for my needs.
Price may not be the cheapest but service is 1st class. Installed my system within 2 weeks.
One of the easiest companies I have ever dealt with.
I would recommend Energus and their installers, Sunair to anyone in my area.
Everything has been accomplished as advised to date.Yet to get smart meter installed by our energy supplier.
Very Thorough in planning the install. Great sales support.
Responsive to all messages and clear with quote and dates. Only company who gave a good solution for a tricky roof configuration. Would definitely recommend.

Rob from Energus was great to deal with. Heâ€™s knowledgeable and patient without being pushy and was willing to compete for my business.Jane in the office was great in keeping me informed of order progress and install timeframe.The installers (Steel and the boys at Sun Air - Gosford) were fantastic and I highly recommend them. Prompt, fast and tidy.Very happy with our system (Canadian solar and fronius) and getting 40kWh days from an east-west split install.

The system was only installed last Thursday. I've ticked fantastic because I'm sure it will be. We have a 3.36 kW system consisting of 12 Canadian Solar panels and one ABB inverter. I'd like to thank you for your assistance and information provided via your website. I've learned a lot and can sound quite knowledgeable when discussing solar now.

Installation date was first booked on 28Nov.  But due to the bad weather, installation was postponed to 22Nov.The customer service from Energus was OK.  Their communication with the customer was bad.  After the initial deposit, no one contacted me for the date of installation until I contacted them after 3 weeks of the deposit.Other than that, the installation went smoothly.  I still need to contact AGL to let them know about my solar installation.Thank you
Rob and Jane answered all my questions and tailored the system to suit. They do their best to make sure you have a good solar experience.

Rob Bandari from Energusâ€™ had excellent customer service. No house visit but spent nearly an hour and a half on the phone with me answering all my questions. He was very well prepared and seemed like he had answers to all the questions on the SolarQuotes website.

We signed up with Energus on the basis they would have the panels installed before Christmas, only to be told, once they had an approved application, that the earliest they could install us was late January or early February. Not good enough. This has cost us money because we are losing over half the summer sun, when we need it most for air conditioning and Christmas events and as we are retirees, every penny counts.

Hi team,We purchased our Solar System through the Hellosolar Company, based in Victoria, their name came up through your listing of Solar Quotes.The team that installed the system were top notch, very friendly, very informative and very thorougher the only delay is with the installing of the smart meter however that is to be installed on the 1st of September!!!!We are looking forward to reduced power bills!!!thank you for giving us a number of Companies who supplied quotes!!Cheers Christine Welsh

Energus were the only company to provide a timely quote, answer my ( multiple ) questions and  be interested in providing us with the best system for our needs. The installers ( Kane) were prompt, friendly, professional and 'treated the installation as if it was my house'.I cannot recommend Energus highly enough, we were very lucky to have chosen them.
Rob made the whole process easy. Installation occurred quickly and without fuss. Although we had a few post-installation hiccups Jane was a great help and they were resolved in an excellent fashion.
I am rating 5 star from start to end....Rob he is great....

Rob from Energus, was great. After receiving our quote, I received a phone call, to see if there were any questions, that needed answering. After a few emails, and return phone calls, we decided to choose Energus, not because of price, (price wasn't the issue). It was customer service. Other companies sent emails, and return phone calls, but were hesitant to upgrade to products we had reasearched on.

Exceptional Service by the team. Special thanks to Rob (Sales Manager) for being my go to person for each and every query. Product quality is very good compared to other cheap options available in the market. Highly recommended to everyone.

They were in touch quickly and were also happy to negotiate a better price. The installers were very friendly and professional and contacted me prior to the job to let me know when they would be arriving. Great customer service all around

Rob at Energus was very honest from the beginning and I was never under pressure to sign any deals. All the information were clear and easy to understand. I did want to go for a larger system but due to the limited space of my roof it was not ideal and this was clearly explained to me. Ryan and his team did a fantastic job on the date of the installation as well as the technicians who came to install the new meters later on. Communication could have been better but they did contact me about the delay and I had no problems getting through to their Customer Service. Overall, I am happy that I went through SolarQuotes and picked Energus.
Energus was very informative and knew their products very well actually told us what we didnt need unlike other quotes that tried to upsell  - installers were wonderful too.

The total process took about 7 weeks from organising the 3 quotes to having the final meter installed. The time span from paying the deposit to switching the system on was 4 weeks.Unfortunately an error by the installers damaged our ceiling. This was rectified quickly and the upside of the mistake was a freshly painted ceiling by a professional painter paid by the installer.I felt information flow was poor. I needed to ring several times to find out was was happening.  The installer did not ring the day before. No excuse was given nor an apology.I am still waiting for any warranty paperwork to arrive. I am assuming that this exists as I just paid out $8000 for a product. The only comment I have re warranties is on the original quote.It is too early to make comment re efficiencies, quality of system etc but out of my 7.2kW system I am noticing that I am generating about 3kW in the middle of the day in Winter. If I had installed a 5kW system would I only be generating about 1.8kW??The general process from Finn's work through to switching it on was relatively painless and I have recommended the process to family and friends.

The whole experience was simplified by using Finn Peacocks website... itâ€™s the second time lâ€™ve used it & would use it again & recommend it to everyone. Iâ€™ve saved time, money & effort. Who doesnâ€™t need that?
Other suppliers wanted twice the money for a system that would produce some 15% extra savings!
System with Sonnen battery will be installed on 24th January

Initial contact from Energus representative was within 4 hours of SolarQuotes website request - very impressed! Planet Power I had to call them after 3 days without contact to arrange a quote, which was another 3 days later - not impressed and put them at a great disadvantage. Energus price was good, about expectations and less than Planet Power. Very happy with system although I think the quality of installation was only average, inverter mounting not quite square & a bit wobbly, still waiting on monitor module to be supplied & installed 2 weeks after install... though panels install looks fine from the ground & electrical works look fine to the outsider :-) Very happy with the energy being produced, I calculate our total benefit (savings plus feed-ins) in exactly 2 weeks is almost exactly 1% of the total purchase price, so given we're just at the start of summer a payback period, ignoring tax benefits, of somewhere between 4 & 5 years is highly possible and in line with or a little better than the estimate provided by Energus.I do think your website & blog is fantastic. The guidance and advice it gave me was absolutely invaluable in a market crowded with competition of unknown quality! I have recommended it & forwarded blog emails on to friends also in the market. Thanks a bundle!
Quick, fast and very informative. The quote and data analysis for choosing the correct size system and location on the house was the most professional I come across

The installation was hassle free and done in one day. Quality of the work is really above average, a very professional job. Energus have proven themselves to me as a very professional company with high standards. Would highly recommend them for a solar installation to anyone.
The energus guy was the most switched on

There were several delays after dates for installation were given. Twice deferred. However , the panels and inverter went in last week, not yet had the bill. Today someone adjusted the meter board to do something. The installers were exceptionally pleasant men, very efficient and competent.You may use the comment but not my  full name on your website.

The only low point was dealing with their head office electrician, everbody was fantastic especially Rob. All the guys who were on site were superb. The workmanship was neat and tidy and very efficient. Very happy with our sysyem.

We have three phase power and I assumed they would be installing a three phase inverter as they only gave the inverter model number in the quote. It wasnâ€™t until I googled the model number after install that I found out it was single phase inverter. I was told that If I wanted a three phase then I would have to buy it and try and sell the single phase myself. They have been a good company to deal with but should have given me the option for a three phase inverter in the quote. They knew our house was three phase before install.
Customer service,installation and quality of system are excellent!

I am still waiting on the login details so I can access the monitoring on the inverter. I have emailed them twice and they will not provide it.The bill was sent 5 days before the installation began and payment was requested on day 1, even though it was 3 days before the installation was complete.The inside roof was damaged by the guy walking on the roof.No one from the company has ever been to my house, they did not contact me after the install.

Deciding what system is best for you would have been much harder if we did not use Solar Quotes when we decided to put a system in. Not only did Solar Quotes recommend three suppliers all in our area but were there to answer any question put to them. Don't do the hard yards let Solar Quotes do the work for you.

At no time did i feel like i was getting lied to or ripped off by Energus Pty Ltd, I was told about every thing up front and the guys that installed the system where a great couple of friendly guys that did a good job.

The price for the system was very competitive. Our roof configuration was difficult but the system was installed efficiently and works well. Rob and the team were diligent in ensuring I was happy with the install and system.

Correspondence was great with all questions answered promptly. While not the cheapest quote I got the price was competitive with good quality components. Charlie was really helpful and swung the sale. System installation went smoothly. The company doing the actual install were also good; only issue was they failed to pre-organise a day and time for the install of the smart meter which came 2+ weeks after the system was installed after being asked for at least 24 hours notice. Luckily I was home on the day.
Energus were a pleasure to deal with. Sales person Charlie was first class. I would highly recommend them.

In addition to the highly competitive price for the system, I was impressed with their professionalism from the outset. Information was readily provided. Also despite the quote being a 'special offer', there was no pressure to sign up. I didn't want to miss out, but equally I wanted to think carefully about my options. Energus provided a time frame and I knew I would not miss out! Once I committed to buying the system, it was installed within a month. The installers were excellent. As sub-contractors, they also spoke highly of Energus. My rating of the quality of the system may well be conservative, since it was only installed 2 days ago.Since the installation, I have raised some technical questions which have all been promptly and thoroughly answered by Energus.
System has not been installed yet so I'm basing responses on communications to date.The company has kept us informed every step of the way. Installation is at the end of next week.
They weren't able to install before Christmas due to backlog so can't really comment yet

Communication with Energus was good and installation took place on the date specified. The system seems to be working well, though I believe the Chinese panels (Jinko) and inverter (Zeverlution) are just average quality and efficiency. Price and the salesman were what made me settle on this system as I found the information on components confusing. Each solar installer seems to 'push their own barrow' in this regard.The only criticism I have of the installation is that 2 roof tiles over the eaves were not put back properly leaving the wall cavity open to the rain that fell the following night.
Kept putting off installation after I'd paid which made me nervous.
Can't think what they could have done better.
